title: Column and group counts update straight after a successful change
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Location has several eligible technicians (Clockable, Active, role not Office / not Time Clock User, enrolled here) and seeded work orders spread across statuses (Estimate, Approved, In Progress, Review/Ready for Review, Complete, Invoiced, Paid, Declined, Imported), including at least one with no lead technician.
  5. In Board View or Tech View.
custom_steps:
1. Note the counts on the source and destination technician headers.
  2. Reassign a work order between them.
  3. Confirm both counts update immediately without a manual refresh.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The counts in column/group headers update immediately after a successful change.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Story 4 Reassign or unassign the lead technician.
